text:
glasses_omar: Pattern is erratic; today found at coffee_table_l1 (20:48) after previous misses at bathroom_shelf_ba1 and bed_b1. Do not default to nightstand_b1 or bathroom spots. Check coffee_table_l1, bed_b1, and bathroom_shelf_ba1 with equal priority.

glass_omar: Highly mobile between kitchen and bedroom. Today found at cupboard_k1 (20:38) and nightstand_b1 (22:36). Previous assumption of kitchen_table_k1 or sink_k1 was wrong. Check cupboard_k1, nightstand_b1, and kitchen_table_k1. Do not default to sink_k1.

water_bottle_omar: New pattern. Missed dish_rack_k1 (20:36) by assuming kitchen_table_k1. Check dish_rack_k1 and kitchen_table_k1.

charger_omar: New pattern. Missed nightstand_b1 (22:36) by assuming entry_hook_e1. Check nightstand_b1 and desk_b1. Do not default to entry spots.

mug_omar: Retain previous note. Unstable between kitchen_table_k1, counter_k1, and sink_k1. Check kitchen_table_k1 and counter_k1 first.

razor_omar: Retain previous note. Alternates between sink_ba_ba1 and bathroom_shelf_ba1. Check both.

book_omar: Retain previous note. Frequently on bed_b1. Check bed_b1 and couch_l1 first.

General: The heuristic "coffee_table_l1 is dominant for Omar’s items" is partially valid for glasses but invalid for mugs/glasses/bottles. Kitchen spots (cupboard_k1, dish_rack_k1) and bedroom spots (nightstand_b1, bed_b1) are frequent locations. Do not default to coffee_table_l1 for kitchenware or chargers.
